note: Policy actions: the summary of an item is the document's own summary or the first paragraph of its printed text. When the summary is empty, say what the title says and no more: do not infer what the document decides, whom it affects or why it matters from a company's name, an agency's name or a docket number, and choose the sector only from words the title itself holds. Every item here is a policy action, so the sector is the part of the energy system the action applies to (generation, gas, oil, nuclear, transmission and the others); choose policy only when the summary and the title name no part of it.
